title: Caregiving Jobs vs. AI: Projections, Wages and AI-Exposure Scores for Elder-Care Occupations
description:
BLS 2025-35 employment projections, OEWS May 2025 wages and four AI-exposure/care measures (BLS relative AI exposure, Microsoft AI applicability, Anthropic observed exposure, O*NET 'Assisting and Caring for Others') for 14 hands-on care occupations and 11 high-exposure office/tech comparison occupations.

Live page: https://familyestateguide.com/estate-planning-data/caregiving-jobs-vs-ai/. Published by Family Estate Guide.

Rights review: None. Third-party columns were checked: Microsoft 'Working with AI' data is CC BY 4.0, the Anthropic Economic Index data is released under CC-BY, and O*NET is CC BY 4.0. All are compatible with redistribution under CC BY 4.0 with attribution, given in Sources. Changes made: rounding, code averaging and percentile calculation. Note: the Anthropic Hugging Face card lists 'license: mit' in its metadata while its README says 'Data released under CC-BY'. Both permit redistribution with attribution.

Not legal, tax, financial or medical advice. Figures are estimates with sampling error; legal rules change. Verify anything important with the original source or a qualified professional.
